posts.content_md:
Well, the color tests have been coming out great in DCG. But now as the temperature of the celar is below operating conditions I have moved to doing other holography related tasks. For one, I am trying my hand at modeling. I must say, I am not that great but am very pleased with the results thus far. It will allow me to do objects that are originals, which excites me. I am also giving the lab a face lift. Hopefull with my new designs I should have more space, a nicer coating area and be able to heat it next year.

Happy Hologramming!
